observations: House attempt 1 was too front-facing; attempt 2 increased the roof proportion and is selected for the diagnostic atlas.
Tree and streetlight retain too much frontal presentation relative to the source city camera.
All three selected sources contain near-magenta background noise; measured exact-key ink bounds span the whole source. Trimmed packing would therefore be misleading.
Native pixel size and relative scale are not consistently controlled. Tree and streetlight are too large compared with the house if used unscaled.
The transparent house retry has partial opacity and visible halo; not selected.
Packing improves organisation and gives real frame rectangles and source hashes, but does not improve the artwork or resolve scene fidelity.
